integrity: The proof is analytic and self-contained except for the stated definition of the radius and standard Cayley--Hamilton and elementary integration. The Python checker supplies finite diagnostics only, not a proof across all p.
scientific_limitations: The exact formula is for trace-zero complex two-by-two matrices and finite \(1\le p<\infty\). It does not classify arbitrary matrices or larger dimensions; older equivalent identities may exist under other terminology.
title: Determinant law and a critical-exponent reversal for the Cartesian radius of traceless two-by-two matrices
